answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can demand independent revenue-stream proof: each identity must show real income from its own product or service, payment-processor receipts in its own name, like a pearl grown slowly in one oyster, not copied across shells. A farm can spin up fifty accounts, but it cannot fake fifty separate paying customer bases. On the horizon, one oasis of genuine demand outweighs a desert of sock puppets; identities sharing a single revenue source collapse to one voice.
